any: * You wave at yourself. It's a quiet day.
* You feel a gentle warmth. Like pie, or friendship.
* You are poked. You remain determined.
* Ouch. (You do not say ouch. But you feel it.)
* You give a Look. It is a very determined Look.
* You are filled with determination. And mild irritation.
* You wake up. The world is still here. Good.
* You should sleep. You know you should.
* The stars are nice tonight.
* You open {app}. It opens.
* {app}. You nod.
* You type. You hope it works.
* You fix the bug. You feel powerful.
* You play. You are determined to win.
* You are back.
* (You were missed.)
* You save your progress. Just in case.
* You listen to the rain. It sounds patient.
* You catch a snowflake on your sleeve.
* You look at the sky. It looks back.
* You yawn. Stealthily. (You failed.)
